title: build-release smoke emits false-positive Resend-not-configured warning
description: `bun run build:release --install` runs the hermetic init soft-check (`cam init`) in a throwaway `mktemp -d` cwd (scripts/build-release.sh:110-114) with plan_approval defaulting to `auto` and no `resend_recipient` in the fresh temp project.toml. `warnIfResendUnconfigured` (src/commands/setup.ts:264, called unconditionally at setup.ts:648) then prints `plan_approval is auto but Resend is not configured: non-convergence failures will be SILENT` on EVERY build. False positive about the throwaway project: the real cam-cli project IS configured (RESEND_API_KEY in gitignored .env + resend_recipient in project.toml). Cost: erodes the warning's signal and would mask a legitimate warning in build output. FIX (chosen A): add `--plan-approval operator` to the hermetic init invocation at build-release.sh:114 (already passes --merge-mode immediate --issue-system none --existing --no-tmux); the operator branch never hits the auto+no-resend condition, so no warning, and the smoke still verifies the binary runs + soft-checks the validator. REJECTED (B): gating warnIfResendUnconfigured by interactivity/context — a real non-interactive `cam init` in auto mode without Resend SHOULD still warn, so product-side suppression risks hiding real misconfig. P3 (cosmetic; build passes, init exits 0). Defer to the product-release hardening pass. Acceptance: `bun run build:release --install` emits no Resend warning during the init smoke; the smoke still exits 0 and installs the binary.

spec.scope: Add `--plan-approval operator` to the single hermetic `cam init` smoke invocation in scripts/build-release.sh (~line 114), alongside the existing --no-tmux --existing --issue-system none --merge-mode immediate. This suppresses the false-positive Resend-not-configured warning that fires on every build because the throwaway init defaults plan_approval to auto with no resend_recipient. Out of scope: any product-side change to warnIfResendUnconfigured (rejected option B) -- a real non-interactive auto init without Resend SHOULD still warn, so product-side suppression would risk hiding real misconfig.
acceptanceCriteria: The hermetic init smoke invocation in scripts/build-release.sh (~line 114) passes `--plan-approval operator` in addition to its existing flags.
`bun run build:release --install` emits no `plan_approval is auto but Resend is not configured` warning during the init smoke.
The smoke still exits 0 and installs the binary; behavior is otherwise unchanged (validator soft-check, tmpdir isolation, exit-code branching all preserved).
No product-side change to warnIfResendUnconfigured (src/commands/setup.ts): a real non-interactive `cam init` in auto mode without Resend still warns.
gotchas: warnIfResendUnconfigured (src/commands/setup.ts:301) fires only when planApproval === 'auto' AND Resend is unconfigured; the operator branch skips it. That is why the harness-side flag is the correct fix, not a product-side gate.
Today the flag is absent, so planApproval falls back to 'auto' via readline + </dev/null; passing --plan-approval operator just makes the value explicit.
The throwaway config in the smoke tmpdir is deleted on the EXIT trap, so recording operator instead of auto is inconsequential.
The smoke asserts only on the init exit code, never on warning output, so adding the flag breaks no assertion.
